name: feishu
description: Official @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp from the Feishu Open Platform: exposes Feishu OpenAPI as MCP tools, with --oauth for app authorization. For the international Lark edition add -d https://open.larksuite.com/.

metadata.install: No installation needed (npx fetches on demand); alternatively npm install @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp -g
metadata.env_hint: App credentials are passed with -a <app_id> -s <app_secret>; this example uses placeholders, see README for real values
